notes.title: New Features, Fresh Fixes, and a Big Discount!
notes.content:
[h3]The Wildwood boardwalk just got an upgrade![/h3][p]
We’ve been hard at work polishing, improving, and adding to [i]Wildwood Down[/i] and today, we’re rolling out our first [b]major update[/b].[/p][p]Here’s what’s new:[/p][list][*][p]🎨 [b]Enhanced visuals & polish[/b] – cleaner effects, camera work polish, and better performance.[/p][/*][*][p]🕹 [b]Gameplay improvements[/b] – fixes and tweaks for puzzles and exploration along with WASD controls for keyboard.[/p][/*][*][p]🧩 [b]New Hint System [/b]- The new hint system now has a "Soft hint" or "Direct hint" option throughout the entire game. So you can get a gentle nudge or a more direct answer to the puzzle at hand in-order to continue through the story whenever you wish.[/p][/*][*][p]🎪 [b]Chapter Select [/b]- We added an entire [b]Chapter Select Menu[/b] that will unlock sequentially as you play through the game. So you can jump in and revisit a favorite puzzle or cutscene and lot easier.[/p][/*][*][p]🌊 [b]Quality of life updates[/b] – Improved navigation, dialogue adjustments, and more.[/p][/*][*][p]🐞 [b]Bug fixes[/b] – the boardwalk’s a little less buggy wuggy. ːsteamhappyː[/p][/*][/list][p]And that’s not all! We’re celebrating with a [b]25% discount[/b] for one week only![/p][p]Whether you’re just starting your adventure on the Wildwood boardwalk or returning to solve the mysteries with Daniel, now’s the perfect time to dive in. 
[/p][p]👉 Don’t miss out. The [b]25% off deal only lasts until September 22nd[/b]!

notes.title: One Week of Wildwood Down + Patch Notes!
notes.content:
[p]Hi everyone,[/p][p]It’s hard to believe it’s already been a week since [i]Wildwood Down[/i] launched! 🎉
We’re blown away by the support, laughs, and kind words from everyone who’s played so far. From the bottom of our hearts thank you!
[/p][list][*][p]We’ve also been busy squashing some bugs and polishing things up based on your feedback. Here’s what’s new:
[/p][olist][*][p]Added WASD and Arrow Key Movements for "keyboard and mouse" control scheme.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Hint System to show subtle hints and then more obvious hints on the second check (Sometimes) We may do this more as we get time to implement it.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed "No Timed Events" Mode for a couple puzzles to work more efficiently.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a visual for the "Wrestling Tutorial" to go along with the Dialogue explanation.[/p][/*][*][p]Polished and Fixed some "controller" bugs.[/p][/*][*][p]Squashed a few other minor bugs here and there.[/p][/*][*][p]Also Wildwood Down is now STEAM DECK Verified! [/p][/*][/olist][/*][/list][p]We’re already working on more updates and quality-of-life improvements. Keep the feedback coming! Your input is helping us make the game better every day.[/p][p][/p][p]If you’ve enjoyed your time with Wildwood Down, leaving a Steam review really helps us spread the word to more players. So please take a moment and let us know what you think if you haven't yet! 🙏🙌  If you're waiting to complete the game you can always go back and edit your review when you finish the story. [/p][p][/p][p]Thank you all again for an amazing launch week! Here’s to you and yours![/p][p] - Micah & Luke @crashablestudios    [/p][p][/p][p]Here's A fun little hype trailer sharing some reviews we've received so far! 🤙😁👍🙌[/p][previewyoutube="1Ag4X7FkBKI;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: “All the moments we’ll never forget”
notes.content:
[h3]We're just two weeks away from Wildwood Down's launch, and I wanted to take a moment to reflect on the crazy journey getting here. The ups and downs, the incredible people we've met, and the opportunities we've been honored to be part of. So here it goes! [/h3][list][*][p]To start back a year or so ago [b]Wildwood Down[/b] was chosen to be part of [b]Day of the Devs 2024[/b] in San Fran and we ended up kickin it and BBQ'n with [b]Tim Schafer[/b] and it was an amazing time. Later at the event he came through and played our game's demo with his kid. It was such a surreal moment for us as he is one of our childhood heroes with all the Adventure games that he's made and been a part of.  To have him watching and enjoying our little Demo was an unreal experience.[/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44581993/63a08762fe316b81ee04c769ec9fc4ea772c6180.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44581993/d71c644bf970b8ed2d0e8b42cf50c368138c038d.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44581993/71226c1d2dedfba3c765c28b696d409a2165bca2.png"][/img][/carousel][p]
[/p][/*][*][p]Then we got to be a part of [b]Adventure Game Fan Fair[/b] in Washington State and met a lot of other founders of the Adventure Game genre. Sierra Legends like [b]Ken & Roberta Williams[/b] (Kings Quest), [b]Al Lowe[/b] (Leisure Suit Larry), and tons of other incredible people who worked on those original point-and-clicks. We had [b]Dave Gilbert[/b] of Wadjet Eye playing our Demo there (I was nervous as all get out ːsteamhappyː) So this event was also an incredible memorable time for us and having Dan there at the booth was just a blast! [/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44581993/b3e84cc547c1fa76deaf0d6a2606f7fd4a0b14bf.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44581993/0d37f06775ead381aa98d953e197207f7ff860f2.png"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]We had so much fun recording Dan's dialogue lines for the game and hanging out into the wee hours of the night last Christmas season. I'll never forget those nights. ːsteamhappyː[/p][h3]Watch - [url="https://youtube.com/shorts/ETuWICSKzkc?feature=share"]Clip of Dan recording dialogue[/url][/h3][p][/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]We had an amazing "Steam Next Fest" in February. Live streaming the Demo with Dan right along side us as he pied me and Luke in the face toward the end of our stream.  [/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44581993/5e88023b9aa228a9ee1afe0d18af93a7103d5374.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44581993/8303df2f35f3f74356db08c06c252fee42a1a6a5.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44581993/f3fd8f3a0ec5f919d7feebdb19fa5f47251b4ed5.png"][/img][/carousel][/*][/list][p][/p][list][*][p]Then... A few months ago Dan was diagnosed with cancer and we flew out to the west coast and stayed with him in the hospital. He is now on his way to full recovery and he his home and doing much better.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44581993/463850ece96ba7e64fa46d7588eb55c953b4abeb.png"][/img][/p][p] This was a earth shattering and terrible time and we are so glad Dan is doing better. A lot of fans of Wildwood Down and different voice actors joined in sending Dan gifts and encouraging messages during this time and we will never forget it. You can watch the video below that shows some clips of that time and also some back story and Dan winning and receiving an award for Diversity at the "BIG festival" in brazil.  [/p][h3][b]Watch the behind the scenes[/b][/h3][previewyoutube="S6mGzUwKOIQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][/*][*][p]I recently had the honor of joining a Podcast at [b]"Adventure Game Podcast"[/b] to talk about Wildwood Down and tell some stories. You can check that out here if you'd like.[/p][h3][b]Wildwood Down on Adventure Game Podcast[/b]
[b][url="https://podcasts.apple.com/ie/podcast/interview-with-micah-orsie-of-crashable-studios/id1447524299?i=1000718325657"]iTunes[/url]
[url="https://open.spotify.com/episode/2RSHhvVRI3Wsr001FMeF8M?si=8f282314b6f04267"]Spotify[/url][/b][/h3][p][/p][/*][*][p]I'm sure there are 20 other things that will pop in my head once I post this, but for now I just want to say thank you to all the [b]Fans, Friends, Families, Organizations, and everyone[/b] that has been with us on this journey! Also... [b][i]"Hola"[/i][/b] to all the new comers that are just discovering the game! [/p][p][b]We can't wait for you all to play and enjoy "[i]Wildwood Down"[/i] in only 2 weeks! (Aug.7th)[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44581993/bafb6a5c3fcdd2de8d3c0296a1dde6401b4c21e8.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Thank you. Thank you. Thank you. [/h2][h2]Mad love from us here at Crashable Studios![/h2][list][*][p][b]Micah, Luke, and Dan[/b] [/p][/*][/list][/*][/list]
